name: Software Development
description: Spec → Implement → Verify → Release → Retrospect, with built-in quality gates.

phases.title: Spec
phases.description: Define requirements, acceptance criteria and key technical decisions.
aiInstructions: Read the handoff and context.json. If the requirements are still vague, call the Skill tool with align-scope and settle what done means first.
Turn the settled scope into vertical-slice tasks with their dependencies: call the Skill tool with slice-work.
Record key technical choices (framework, data structures, boundaries) as decisions.

phases.title: Implement
phases.description: Complete the tasks one by one against the spec.
aiInstructions: Take work from the frontier: the highest-priority task in Next steps that you can take, or list_tasks { ready: true }. Follow the execution guidelines in rules.json.
Build each task test-first: call the Skill tool with test-first. For a bug whose cause is not obvious, call it with debug-loop.
If validate_task_specs is in your tool list, a task that changes behaviour writes its spec delta under tasks/<task-id>/specs/ before it is marked done (nextup_docs/modules/specs.md).
Mark done and commit after each atomic task.
When several independent tasks are ready at once, suggest the user run /work-the-frontier to build them in parallel.

phases.title: Verify
phases.description: Tests, checks and a real run.
aiInstructions: Review the work on two axes — the project's conventions and what the tasks asked for: call the Skill tool with two-axis-review, then fix what it finds.
Run the full test suite and actually exercise the main flows; give the user the before-and-after evidence they need to mark tasks verified.
Record the verification results and known limitations as decisions.

exitGates.prompt: All tests pass and the main flows work in a real run

phases.title: Release
phases.description: Assemble the deliverables and release notes.
aiInstructions: Put the deliverables and usage instructions into artifacts/.
Write artifacts/release-notes.md: call the Skill tool with ship-notes — the smallest picture of the change, before-and-after evidence, and whether it can be undone.

phases.title: Retrospect
phases.description: Turn friction points into rule improvements.
aiInstructions: Call the Skill tool with retrospect: it starts from post_mortem_candidates and the flywheel prompts, and turns mechanical mistakes into checks, the rest into lessons, boundaries or rejections.
Write the improvements back into executionGuidelines and leave a revisionHistory entry.
